companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Companies to pull complaints for, one per line, as the CFPB spells them ("WELLS FARGO & COMPANY", "CAPITAL ONE FINANCIAL CORPORATION"). Matched exactly. If a company returns nothing, try a keyword under Search terms instead.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Free-text searches across complaints, one per line ("zelle scam", "overdraft fee"). Use these when you do not know a company's exact name or want an issue across companies.

product.title: Product
product.description: Limit to one product type (applied to every company and search). Leave empty for all.
enum: Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports
Money transfer, virtual currency, or money service
Payday loan, title loan, or personal loan

state.title: State
state.description: Limit to one US state by two-letter code ("CA", "NY"). Leave empty for nationwide.

sinceDays.title: Received within (days)
sinceDays.description: Only complaints received in the last N days. 0 = no date limit (goes back through history as far as the row cap allows).

withNarrativeOnly.title: Only complaints with a narrative
withNarrativeOnly.description: Only complaints where the consumer wrote a description of what happened (the most useful ones). About a third of complaints have a published narrative.

includeNarrativeText.title: Include narrative text
includeNarrativeText.description: Include the full consumer narrative in each row. Turn off for smaller rows when you only need the structured fields.

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new complaints only
newOnly.description: Remember complaints already returned and emit only ones not seen before. Run on a schedule for a clean feed of new complaints - quiet runs cost nothing.

maxPerQuery.title: Complaints per company or search
maxPerQuery.description: How many complaints to return per company or search term, newest first.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
